offering_description.value: TruBridge provides outsourced billing and revenue cycle software to hospitals and physician practices. It also supplies electronic health record systems to community hospitals and helps customers implement them.

primary_products.value: Medical billing software; electronic claims clearinghouse software; electronic health records; hospital financial management software

primary_services.value: Outsourced medical billing and collections; medical coding; claims processing and denial management; software implementation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Community hospitals, health systems, physician practices and outpatient clinics

end_markets.value: Community and rural hospital care; health systems; ambulatory care

revenue_model.value: service fees: Outsourced billing, coding, collections and software implementation; subscription: Hosted billing and electronic health record software; transaction or usage fees: Electronic claims processing and clearinghouse transactions; licensing or royalties: Electronic health record and hospital management software licenses
revenue_model.category: service fees; subscription; transaction or usage fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Processes patient accounts and payer claims for hospitals and physician practices; software / platform: Turns clinical and billing data into workflows for hospitals and clinics

geography_served.value: US national: Hospitals and physician practices across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Outsourced revenue cycle management, billing and claims software, and hospital electronic health records

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving hospitals, health systems and physician practices

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Patient data handling and electronic billing subject to HIPAA privacy, security and transaction standards

notes: The current extent of operations outside the United States and any recent portfolio changes are uncertain.
